# GitHub repository metadata

Paste these into the repository settings (the gear next to "About") after publishing.

## Description (350 characters max)

```
SideCal: free, open-source sidebar calendar for macOS. See your whole day at a glance, time-block by dragging, get a menu bar countdown to your next event. Works with Apple Calendar (iCloud, Google, Exchange). Tiny Rust + Tauri app, no Electron, no telemetry.
```

Shorter variant (for places with tight limits):

```
Free sidebar calendar for macOS: time blocking by dragging, auto-hide, menu bar countdown. Rust + Tauri.
```

## Website

The GitHub Pages address: `https://<your-github-user>.github.io/<repository-name>/`

## Topics (up to 20)

```
macos sidebar-calendar side-calendar calendar menu-bar menubar-app time-blocking timeboxing
productivity productivity-tools apple-calendar eventkit rust tauri open-source desktop-app
planner agenda scheduling
```

## Turning on the website

Settings → Pages → Build and deployment → Source: **Deploy from a branch** → Branch: `main`, folder `/docs` → Save.
